title: Your usual, with a little twist.

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.text: Jeg vil gjerne ha en kaffe med havremelk.

lines.speaker: Barista
lines.text: Selvfølgelig. Skal du sitte her eller ta med?

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.text: Jeg vil gjerne ta den med. Hva koster den?

questions.prompt: How will the customer have the coffee?
options: At a table in the café
questions.explanation: “Ta den med” means to take it away. The barista offers a choice and the customer chooses takeaway.

questions.prompt: How much does the coffee cost?
questions.explanation: “Førtifem” is forty-five. Listen to the order of the number parts.

phrases.text: Jeg vil gjerne ha en kaffe med havremelk.
phrases.meaning: I would like a coffee with oat milk.
phrases.tip: Keep “Jeg vil gjerne ha …” and swap the drink.

phrases.text: Jeg vil gjerne ta den med.
phrases.meaning: I would like to take it away.
phrases.tip: “Ta med” is useful whenever you order takeaway.

opening: Hei! Hva kan jeg hjelpe deg med?
sampleError: Jeg vil gjerne har en kaffe med havremelk.

correction.why: After the modal verb “vil”, use the infinitive “ha”, not the present-tense “har”.
